items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: And they had Professor Rokishield, AJ P. and Dave Perkins. And all those big time men. But they, for the judges, you know, professors for the judges.

ctx.x: He can play now, John Porter.

Yeah, that's what they tell me. Yeah. But well, John, John come from the old school, you know, like that thing. And so, they put the play cards out and in the paper about the two bands. And then they, they, they, they, they, they wasn't going to bust, you know. Because, so, that night they had the little old state man up there. And they had Professor Rokishield, AJ P. and Dave Perkins. And all those big time men. But they, for the judges, you know, professors for the judges. So, David Jones looked smart. When,…
say happy women to come play with me how did you do that?
